title: Impact of Treatment Induced Premature Menopause on Quality of Life
brief_summary: To understand the impact of treatment induced menopause on quality of life and sexuality following blood and marrow transplantation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* premenopausal
* sexually active women
* able to read and write English

Exclusion Criteria:

\- postmenopausal females
study_population: Women become menopausal as a result of BMT
